description.value: Samurai Sushi & Teriyaki is an authentic Japanese restaurant in Parksville on the east coast of Vancouver Island, located directly on the East Island Highway — a primary cycling corridor. It serves sushi and teriyaki for both dine-in and takeout, making it a convenient stop for cyclists travelling the Island Route.
